rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Independent, privacy-first search layer for AI agents providing unfiltered access to web knowledge through 8 search tools covering text, images, videos, news, books, unified parallel search, and URL content extraction. Supports both stdio and streamable HTTP transport, with one-click Vercel deployment and Docker support. Built with FastAPI and the DDGS library for metasearch functionality.
